name: naaudio-audiospace
author: Adam Noble - Noble Architecture
dependencyNote: There is no build step and no node_modules at runtime. Three.js is vendored as a curated file drop under 04__Src__Dependencies__VersionLocked and resolved by the import map in NaAudio__App__.html. This block records the locked version so npm can fetch a matching checkout when the vendor drop needs extending.
runtimeNote: AudioSPACE is a static site. The Python server exists so ES modules load at all - file:// blocks them - and so the audio bank gets correct MIME types and range support.
